faq.title: You might be wondering.
faq.intro: Photos, the first 24 hours, credits: here are the answers, with links if you’d like more detail.

availability.question: When and where will Histae be available?
availability.answer: The iOS and Android app is in development. The initial launch is planned for France, with no confirmed public date yet. Official store links will be published on this website as soon as they open.

account.question: How will I create an account?
account.answer: Access is designed to be passwordless, using a one-time code sent by SMS. The initial launch supports French +33 phone numbers.

discovery.question: How are suggested profiles selected?
discovery.answer: Histae checks both people’s preferences: age, who you are looking for and maximum distance must work for each of you. Compatible profiles are shown in order of proximity. Blocks in either direction, saved likes or passes, and people you already have a recorded match with are excluded.

match.question: How does a match work?
match.answer: After two mutual likes, you can talk for 24 hours. Sending is then paused for a further 24 hours: history remains readable and each person can continue or end the match. Choices stay private until both agree, reopening the conversation. A decline or no mutual agreement within the deadline ends the match without naming who declined.

photos.question: Do I need to add a photo, and who can see it?
photos.answer: A photo is required to access the feed, but it never appears in profile suggestions. Within a match, photos are revealed only after both people agree, independently of the decision to continue the conversation.

pricing.question: What is the difference between Free and Premium?
pricing.answer: You can create a profile, match and start chatting for free. Free includes {freeCredits} weekly credits to continue conversations, up to {weeklyMaximum} extensions. An optional video earns one credit, with up to {advertisingStock} ad credits in reserve. Premium removes the quota and advertising. Current prices are on the Pricing page and confirmed before payment.

location.question: How is location used and retained?
location.answer: Location is used only for discovery with separate consent, and the displayed distance is rounded. It becomes stale after one hour, is deleted after 24 hours without an update and disappears immediately when consent is withdrawn.

moderation.question: Can I block or report someone?
moderation.answer: Yes, in the app. Blocking someone ends your matches and prevents another one while the block is active. You can also report them and explain what happened.

privacy.question: How can I exercise my rights or delete my data?
privacy.answer: Histae provides dedicated journeys for access, portability, correction, restriction, objection and erasure. The export gathers account data; deletion removes the main data, anonymises messages and closes matches.

sourceCode.question: Can I read the code and carry out a security audit?
sourceCode.answer: Original Histae code is public for inspection and security audits. Reuse, including non-commercial reuse, redistribution and use in another project are prohibited without prior written permission. This is not an open-source license. Third-party components retain their own licenses. External contributions are not accepted.

emptyFeed.question: Why is my feed empty?
emptyFeed.answer: Check your profile, photo, preferences and consent choices, and make sure pause mode is off. Your location and the other person’s must both be less than an hour old. People you have already liked, passed, blocked or matched with are also excluded. You can update your location or adjust your preferences if you wish; an empty feed may simply mean that no profiles meet these conditions at the moment.

ranking.question: Are profiles rated or ranked by popularity?
ranking.answer: No. Histae does not assign attractiveness ratings or popularity scores, and does not use an Elo system. Profiles that meet both people’s preferences are shown in order of proximity. Receiving more likes does not move a profile up the feed.

pause.question: Can I take a break without losing my matches?
pause.answer: Yes. Pause mode, available in your profile, removes you from new suggestions and stops discovery of new profiles. Your existing matches and conversations remain available. When you resume, the usual requirements apply, including a recent location.
